about_the_game:
Your controller just became an instrument.

Your controller just became an instrument. SONGBOY is the first video game for making music. Grab your controller and craft songs in seconds.

Built to be explored.

Whether you're a seasoned producer or someone who's always wanted to create, SONGBOY meets you where you are. Make trap, house, indie, pop, or invent something entirely new. Your controller. Your sound. Your story.

Key Features

Controller-Native Creation

  • Works with any controller out of the box

  • Feels like second nature from the first beat

  • Sound amazing in your first session

Professional Output

  • Studio-grade results from intuitive controls

  • Export stems to your DAW or share with the world

  • Real music, made through play

Perfect For

  • Gamers who love to make music

  • Producers seeking faster/unique workflows

  • Anyone who's felt locked out by traditional tools

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.14 (Mojave)
  • Processor: Intel i5 2.7GHz / Apple M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics or better
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Core Audio compatible
  • Additional Notes: Gaming controller recommended
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 10.14 (Mojave)
  • Processor: Intel i7 3.0GHz / Apple or M2 or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon integrated graphics
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Core Audio compatible
  • Additional Notes: Gaming controller recommended

name: SONGBOY

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350 equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics / capable of handling Unreal Engine
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Gaming controller recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 7 2700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics / capable of handling Unreal Engine
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Gaming controller recommended
